description: The OwlChart AI Metric: one 0 to 100 score for the whole AI market (47 AI stocks: chips, memory, equipment, cloud, neoclouds, power, data centres, Asia) and its state: PUMPING, DUMPING, CORRELATING, DECOUPLED, BUBBLE RISK or DRAGGING THE MARKET, with momentum, breadth, distance from the high, strength against the S&P 500, correlation and bubble heat. The latest reading is always returned. The full history, the per-stock closes and CSV need the AI Metric pass. A data reading, never a trade instruction.
